description: This file contains implementation of sharding operations for embedding layers in a distributed PyTorch environment. It includes functions for handling different sharding schemes (row-wise and column-wise), validation, and the main sharded embedding operation integrating with PyTorch's distributed communication primitives.

methods.name: sharded_embedding(types, args, kwargs, pg)
methods.description: Main function that dispatches embedding lookups based on sharding spec, supporting both row-wise and col-wise sharding of the weight tensor.

methods.name: _validate_embedding_param(args, kwargs)
methods.description: Validates parameters for the sharded embedding operation, ensuring correct types, sizes, and supported sharding specifications.

methods.name: _handle_col_wise_sharding( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, pg )
methods.description: Handles the logic for col-wise sharding of embedding weights including input gathering and max_norm processing.

methods.name: _handle_row_wise_sharding( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, rank, pg )
methods.description: Handles the logic for row-wise sharding of embedding weights, including input gathering, masking, and reduce_scatter to assemble output.

ctags.name: _handle_col_wise_sharding
ctags.signature: ( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, pg )

ctags.name: _handle_row_wise_sharding
ctags.signature: ( input, world_size, weight, local_shard, max_norm, norm_type, padding_idx, rank, pg )
